resources.string: Launch selected payment apps after Detach pauses protection.

Blocks selected Instagram feeds and Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You can choose whether Stories, DMs and reels shared in DMs stay available. It only looks at Instagram, YouTube and Detach\'s own Settings pages (to stop it being switched off on impulse). It never reads other apps, has no internet access, and stores only its switches and a hashed password.
